en: Vintage monochrome postcard with a tinted illustration of two women in long dresses seated on stone steps in front of ancient ruins. In the background is a small classical temple-like structure with columns, likely part of the Acropolis. French and Greek captions are printed in red, and there is handwriting and a circular seal near the bottom. The publisher information at the bottom reads that it is from Athens.
